blendVariants.label: Natural
blendVariants.title: Primeros Nicaragua — Tin of 6
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Black pepper, roasted coffee, leather and creamy sweetness give the standard Nicaragua Primeros a brighter, less sweet profile than the Maduro. The Nicaraguan Habano wrapper keeps the smoke peppery and aromatic while the Ecuadorian binder and Nicaraguan-Dominican filler add coffee, leather and a soft creamy finish.
blendVariants.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists the exact tin of 6 at A$132 (A$22 per cigar); Sydney Cigar House lists the exact single at A$23.40.
